listings.name: Status Pill
listings.description: Compact status / badge chip for dashboards and tables. Brief prefers existing Badge primitives.

stencils.title: Status pill
stencils.description: Compact colored status chip (success / warn / danger)
stencils.briefTemplate: Add a Status pill / Badge. Label: {{label}}. Tone: {{variant}}. Prefer the project's Badge / Tag primitive; otherwise install via shadcn badge. Keep height compact for table cells; ensure contrast for the tone.
stencils.licenseNote: MIT-oriented brief; no third-party asset embedded.

listings.name: Empty State Panel
listings.description: Community empty-state composition (icon + title + CTA). Review brief before installing — content enters agent input.

stencils.title: Empty state
stencils.description: Centered empty-state with title, body, and primary CTA
stencils.briefTemplate: Add an Empty State panel. Title: {{title}}. Body: {{text}}. CTA label: {{label}}. Center vertically in the available region. Prefer existing Empty / Illustration patterns; otherwise compose Card + Button. Keep copy concise.
stencils.licenseNote: Community pack — review before shipping to customers.
